title: Who Enters the Record? Paywalls, Contributor Selection, and Social Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies social learning when buying access to previous decisions also determines whose decision enters the record. Individuals first receive private information and then decide whether to pay for access. A positive price selects relatively weak private beliefs. With one founding observation, every buyer copies it, and the record acquires no further information. With a richer initial history, buyers can disagree and the record can improve; nevertheless, a price bounded away from zero prevents complete learning, even with unbounded private beliefs. We then consider a rule under which a buyer makes a preliminary choice before access and a revised choice afterward. A positive probability of implementing the preliminary choice makes it follow the private signal. Retaining both choices restores complete learning under a fixed effective fee or pooled myopic pricing, including with bounded beliefs. The rule reduces willingness to pay

translated_title: 谁进入记录？付费墙、贡献者选择与社会学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了当购买先前决策的访问权限同时决定谁的决策能够进入记录时的社会学习问题。个体首先接收私人信息，然后决定是否付费获取访问权限。正的价格会筛选出私人信念相对较弱的购买者。在只有一个初始观察的情况下，每个购买者都会照搬它，记录因此不再获得进一步的信息。当初始历史较为丰富时，购买者之间可能产生分歧，记录也能得到改进；然而，只要价格保持在远离零的正水平，完全学习就无法实现，即使私人信念是无界的。随后，本文考虑了一种规则：购买者在获取访问权限之前先做出一个初步选择，之后再做出修改后的选择。当初步选择有正的概率被实施时，它会跟随私人信号。同时保留这两个选择能够在固定有效费用或汇总短视定价机制下恢复完全学习，包括在有界信念的情形下。该规则降低了支付意愿。
tldr: 本文揭示了付费墙的正价格会筛选出信念较弱的购买者从而阻碍完全社会学习，而要求购买者在付费前先做出并保留初步选择的规则能够恢复完全的社会学习。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that positive paywall prices select relatively weakly-informed buyers and impede complete social learning, while a rule requiring buyers to make and retain a preliminary choice before access restores complete learning.
